headline: Ratchet & Clank's native port gains music and sharper menus
summary: OpenRAC's native Ratchet & Clank PAL port gains music, speech and sound effects, alongside native UI drawing and sharper text (OpenRAC#6). Camera and Linux Play fixes land, while Discord activity gains live planet, location and bolt information. The separate PAL v2.00 decompilation rises from 78.51% to 78.63% matched code during a broad shared-structure cleanup. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Going Commando retires its generated-source campaign system, imports SDK/library C and adopts GPL-3.0 licensing.
